column2: Bake for about 15-20 minutes until the fish is opaque and flakes easily.
Potatoes and spinach in béchamel
Sauté the onion and spinach in oil until the liquid evaporates.
Whisk the milk and flour and thicken in a small pan.
Arrange the potatoes and spinach in a baking dish and pour over the sauce; bake at 190°C for 25 minutes.
Pasta with sun-dried tomatoes
8 sun-dried tomatoes
A handful of basil
Boil the pasta according to the packet and set aside a ladle of the water.
Soften the sun-dried tomatoes in hot water and chop.
Lightly sauté the garlic in oil and add the tomatoes.
Add the pasta, a little cooking water and the basil and mix.
Purslane salad with walnuts and yogurt
Toss the purslane with the yogurt.
Add olive oil and walnuts on top and serve.
Orzo pilaf with onion and mushrooms
Slice the mushrooms and chop the onion.
Sauté the onion in oil, add the mushrooms and let the liquid evaporate.
Add the orzo and toast for 2 minutes.
Add the hot water and cook over low heat until absorbed.
Leeks in olive oil with orange
Wash the leeks and carrot and slice diagonally.
Stir the vegetables in oil for 4 minutes.
Add the washed rice, orange juice and water.
Cook covered for 25 minutes until the vegetables are soft.
Cauliflower with minced meat
250 g lean minced meat
Sauté the onion in oil, add the mince and cook until it changes colour.
Add the chopped tomatoes.
Add the cauliflower florets and water.
Cook for 25 minutes until the cauliflower is soft and the mince fully cooked.
Baked cheesy zucchini slices
Preheat the oven to 200°C and slice the zucchini into thick rounds.
Beat the egg, and mix the kashar and breadcrumbs in a separate bowl.
Dip the zucchini first in the egg, then in the cheese mixture.
Bake on a tray lined with baking paper for 20-25 minutes until golden.
Pumpkin dessert with cinnamon
600 g pumpkin
3 tablespoons granulated sugar
Peel the pumpkin and cut into large cubes.
Put the pumpkin, sugar and water in a pot.
Cook covered for 25 minutes until the pumpkin is soft.
Once cooled, serve with cinnamon and walnuts.
Baked vegetable mücver balls
Grate the zucchini and carrot and squeeze out the excess liquid thoroughly.
Mix the egg, flour, dill and oil.
Drop small spoonfuls and bake for 25 minutes until cooked inside.
Lemon chicken rice pilaf
1.5 cups hot chicken stock
Wash the rice, soak in lukewarm water for 15 minutes and drain.
Cook the chicken through in a separate pan and break into small pieces.
Toast the rice in butter, add the hot stock and cook covered.
When absorbed, add the chicken and lemon and let rest for 10 minutes.
Broccoli and cheese crêpes
1 cup small broccoli florets
Steam the broccoli for 5 minutes and chop finely.
Whisk the egg, milk and flour until smooth.
Mix the broccoli and crumbled cheese into the batter.
Cook small crêpes on both sides in a lightly greased pan until fully cooked.
Baked lemon sea bass
Thinly slice the onion and lemon and place in a baking dish.
Place the sea bass on top and drizzle with oil.
Bake for 18-22 minutes until the fish is fully cooked and serve with parsley.
Apple yogurt cups
Dice the apple small, soften in a pan for 3-4 minutes and let cool.
Mix the yogurt with honey.
Layer the yogurt, oats and apple in a glass.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and serve straight away.
Green lentil and tomato casserole
Soften the onion and carrot in oil.
Add the tomato, lentils and water.
Cook for 20-25 minutes until the lentils are completely soft.
Cheese poğaça with yogurt and dill
Half a tea glass olive oil
Mix the yogurt, egg and oil, then add the flour and baking powder.
Add the cheese and chopped dill to make a soft dough.
Shape and bake on a tray for 25-30 minutes until cooked inside.
Baked potatoes with yogurt sauce
Preheat the oven to 200°C and cut the potatoes into wedges.
Whisk the yogurt, oil and thyme and coat the potatoes.
Arrange the potatoes in a single layer on the tray.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until soft inside and golden outside.
Chickpea salad with tahini and lemon
Thin the tahini and lemon with 2 tablespoons of water.
Combine the chickpeas with the vegetables.
Add the dressing, mix and serve.
Green lentils with minced meat
Sauté the onion in oil and fry the mince until fully cooked.
Add the tomato paste, lentils and water.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Omelette with roasted pepper and lor
1 roasted kapia pepper
3 tablespoons lor
Chop the roasted pepper small.
Beat the eggs and add the lor and pepper.
Pour the mixture into a lightly oiled pan.
Cook both sides until the egg is fully cooked.
Baked borlotti bean casserole with thyme
1 tea glass hot water
Sauté the onion in oil and add the chopped tomatoes.
Mix in the cooked beans and water and transfer to a baking dish.
Bake for 25 minutes and serve hot.
Rice pilaf with lemon and fresh mint
Toast the rice in butter for 2 minutes.
Add the dill and lemon and let rest for 10 minutes.
Baked chicken and zucchini köfte
300 g minced chicken
Grate the zucchini and squeeze out the liquid well.
Knead the minced chicken, zucchini, egg and breadcrumbs and shape köfte.
Bake on baking paper for 25-30 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked.
Chickpea and spinach sauté
Wash the spinach thoroughly and chop.
Sauté the onion in oil and add the chopped tomato.
Add the chickpeas and spinach.
Cook for 10-12 minutes until the spinach is completely soft.
Carrot soup with orange
4 carrots
Half a cup orange juice
Chop the carrot, potato and onion.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the vegetables are soft.
Blend, add the orange juice and heat briefly.
Oven-roasted eggplant with yogurt
Preheat the oven to 210°C.
Prick the eggplants in a few places and roast for 25-30 minutes until soft.
Once cooled, peel and chop the flesh.
Mix with garlic yogurt and drizzle with oil.
Bulgur with chicken and peas
Add the onion and soften.
Add the bulgur, peas and hot water.
Cook over low heat until the bulgur is soft and let rest for 10 minutes.
Baked cauliflower with tahini
Separate the cauliflower into florets and wash.
Whisk the tahini, lemon, oil and water and coat the cauliflower.
Bake on a tray for 25-30 minutes until soft.
Mini spinach and cheese börek
Wash and finely chop the spinach and mix with the cheese.
Cut the yufka into pieces and make small rolls with the filling.
Brush with the egg, yogurt and oil mixture and bake for 25 minutes until golden.
Carrot yogurt meze with pomegranate
2 tablespoons pomegranate seeds
Grate the carrots and soften in oil for 5-6 minutes.
Let the carrots cool completely.
Mix the yogurt with garlic and add the carrots.
Garnish with pomegranate seeds and serve.
Baked apple semolina cups
4 tablespoons semolina
2 tablespoons sugar
Thicken the milk, semolina and sugar in a pot while stirring.
Grate the apples and mix with cinnamon.
Layer the semolina and apple in small dishes and bake for 15 minutes.
Baked trout with lemon and garlic
Clean and dry the fish.
Mix the lemon, crushed garlic and oil and brush over the fish.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until the fish is fully cooked and serve with parsley.
Pasta with green lentils and mushrooms
Sauté the onion and mushrooms in oil until the liquid evaporates.
Add the cooked lentils and heat for 3 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and serve.
Baked zucchini with tomato and cheese
Slice the zucchini and tomatoes into rounds.
